parsed.explanation: Combined regime is state-enforced at entry and in public: appearance-vs-passport screening at both major gateways, including hours-long detention, genital X-ray checks, mocking, confiscation and deportation in 2025. Gender nonconformity is criminalised; visitors received one-year sentences, three weeks in an effeminate-detainee cell, head-shaving and discarded hormones, and detention mistreatment including beatings and forced rectal exams amounting to torture is documented. No death penalty or same-sex prosecutions since 2015 mitigate slightly, but no anti-discrimination recourse, registration bans and official 'no room' hostility leave no working remedy.

entry_documents.exposure: Entry compares appearance to passport sex; 2025 visitors X-rayed to check genitals against female marker, mocked, refused entry, passports confiscated. Repeated refusals over a decade.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented. No rule shown that updated markers or consistent documents prevent screening.
entry_documents.interaction: Screening outcome feeds detention/deportation and, if admitted, later public-presentation enforcement.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Nine-hour and five-hour airport detentions; 2017 visitors held ~3 weeks, heads shaved, hormones discarded; beatings and forced rectal examinations amounting to torture documented; trans foreigner held since Sept 2022, outcome unresolved.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. Consulate negligence alleged; no effective consular or judicial remedy shown.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest for presentation leads to prolonged custody, abuse, then conversion to deportation rather than protection.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Article 412(2) punishes man disguising as woman to enter women-only space, up to 1 year. Prior broader law applied in mixed-gender mall, streets and workplaces; others held solely for looking feminine.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Not documented. No facilities access aligned with identity shown.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal offence plus local public-morals offence operated together in 2017 convictions.

care_services.exposure: Hormone pills discarded in custody; care continuity interrupted by detention/deportation. Emergency or routine care access for visitors not documented.
care_services.protection: Not documented. Resident surgery restrictions are not a visitor protection.
care_services.interaction: Detention and medication confiscation interact to deny continuity of treatment.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Gender nonconformity itself criminalised; officials declare no room for homosexual/queer acts; censorship of trans content, dating/LGBTQ blocking, venue shutdown. Same-sex conduct criminalised but no prosecutions documented since 2015 and no death penalty.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Complaint-only structure for same-sex conduct is documented, but does not protect presentation offences.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State framing legitimises entry screening, police campaigns and public-morals charges.

minors_guardians.exposure: Not documented. No age-specific entry, facility or custody rule for minors documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: Adult guardian complaint rule for same-sex conduct does not create a documented minor-traveller protection.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Police campaign targeting transsexuals and masculine-presenting women, raids and arrests for cross-dressing, visitors calling police themselves detained, airport staff mocking. No police protection of trans victims documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police are perpetrators of arrests/detention, not a remedy for street hostility.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No national anti-discrimination law, no legal gender recognition for residents, organisations cannot register or operate openly; no remedy for entry refusal or detention shown working.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Not documented. Foreign-government intervention produced dropped charges in one unrelated public-indecency tourist case, not a trans remedy.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of recourse applies across border, custody, facility and care stages.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar or slightly higher: both criminalise presentation, detain visitors for document-appearance mismatch, beatings in custody and illusory remedies. This case is marginally higher because no capital provision for presentation/same-sex conduct is documented and no same-sex prosecutions since 2015, whereas 0.15-A has routine arrests and an unused capital clause.

Materially lower: 0.35-A is exclusion/deportation without imprisonment. Here documented one-year sentences, three weeks in custody, torture-level mistreatment and discarded hormones add imprisonment and custodial abuse beyond exclusion.

Far lower: 0.65-A has national equality protection, brief holding, release, apology and compensation, with courts ordering release. Here entry screening is systematic, criminalisation applies, and no functioning remedy or compensation is documented.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction: appearance-vs-passport screening at main gateways can produce refusal, confiscation and deportation before any public-space encounter; if admitted, presentation laws and local morals offences expose the traveller to arrest, birth-sex/effeminate-cell custody, abuse and hormone loss, ending in deportation. Same-sex complaint-only dead letter and absence of death penalty prevent the lowest tier, but universal entry exposure, criminalised presentation, documented torture and no working recourse keep the combined regime in severe-risk territory for adults alone or with a minor.
